text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap doesn't seem to be feeling well.
Her complexion looks a bit pale, too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Nn... I went to a sweets shop with Tama
that had early morning specials, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I got caught in a packed train on the way there and back.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Between the sheer crowd of people and the suffocating train car,
I started feeling quite sick...
Perhaps due to unexpected mental fatigue, Oguri Cap seemed a bit worn out today.
